title: Optional chaining and safe property access
learningObjectives: Explain optional chaining and safe property access and read or transform JavaScript data safely.

understand.concept: Optional chaining uses ?. to stop property, element, or method access when the value before it is null or undefined. It returns undefined instead of throwing for that access. It can be combined with ?? for defaults, but it does not validate the full data structure.
understand.whyItMatters: Optional chaining makes access to optional API fields safer. Do not use it to hide unexpected data errors or skip required validation.
understand.analogy: Optional chaining checks each doorway before continuing; if a level is absent, it safely stops that access path.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; JavaScript references, serialization, and DOM APIs have precise behaviour defined by the language and web platform.

explain.narrative: The name is Asha; city is undefined because the optional address path is absent.

examples.explanation: The name is Asha; city is undefined because the optional address path is absent.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser console or page displays the selected, transformed, or serialized data.

practise.guidedTask: Read a nested property from a partially missing object using optional chaining. Use ?? only when a meaningful fallback exists.
practise.independentTask: Build a small data-processing or DOM-selection example. Include missing-data handling and explain any shallow-copy or serialization limits.
hints: Check optional properties before accessing them.
Remember shallow copies share nested references.
Handle JSON parsing errors and validate data shape.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Optional chaining and safe property access</title></head><body>
<script>const response={user:{profile:{name:'Asha'}}};const name=response.user?.profile?.name??'Guest';const city=response.user?.profile?.address?.city;console.log(name,city);</script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: What does optional chaining return when an intermediate value is nullish?
questions.explanation: Optional chaining short-circuits and returns undefined for that access.

questions.prompt: What is a safe approach when working with nested or external data?
options: Check structure and handle missing or invalid values
Use JSON parsing as schema validation
questions.answer: Check structure and handle missing or invalid values
questions.explanation: External data must be checked for expected shape and valid values.
